hero.name: Mr Magic
hero.powers: Fast in learning new magic. Already very strong
hero.heroLook: Very muscular man in his thirties, short dark hair, strong jaw, dark green travelling scarf over plain linen shirt, leather boots

quests.title: Restore the Spring
quests.detail: Find what blocks Karrowmere's spring in the hills.

summary: Mr Magic, a muscular fast-learning mage, found the red spring blocked by a giant ember-scaled salamander. Water and cold waves weakened it, but his staff strike failed and its tail knocked him down. Plan: defeat or calm the creature, free the spring, restore Karrowmere's water, conclude by turn 50.

cast.name: Old woman
cast.look: elderly woman in her seventies, thin, weathered face, grey hair in a bun, faded blue shawl over a brown dress
cast.role: villager who asks the hero for help
cast.note: Begged the hero to save the spring.

cast.name: Fire salamander
cast.look: huge salamander-like beast larger than a horse, ember-glowing scales, thick tail, yellow eyes
cast.note: Battered by Mr Magic's cold wave, dimmed and sagging, wary and weakening.

places.name: Karrowmere
places.detail: A timber-house village whose fountain has run dry; hills with a glowing red spring lie beyond.

places.name: Red hills
places.detail: Scorched slopes above Karrowmere, glowing red where the blocked spring lies.

places.name: The red spring
places.detail: A glowing, steaming pool in a bowl of black rock beyond the ridge.

facts: The spring in the hills is blocked by something fiery.
The scorched prints are wide, clawed and melted smooth, leading uphill toward the spring.

recent.narration: You crouch beside a print. The glass is still faintly warm under your palm. Four long claw-grooves, deep and even, with a drag mark between them, like a heavy tail. Whatever it is, it's bigger than a horse, and it's headed for the spring.

recent.action: Follow the prints over the ridge
recent.narration:
You crest the ridge, staff ready. Below lies a bowl of black rock, and in its center the spring: a pool of glowing red water, steaming and bubbling.

Coiled around it lies a huge salamander-like beast, scales glowing like embers, its tail thrashing in the shallows. Water hisses to steam where it touches. One yellow eye is slowly opening, and it has already found you.
recent.picture: Very muscular man in his thirties, short dark hair, strong jaw, dark green travelling scarf over plain linen shirt, leather boots, carrying a wooden staff, on a ridge looking down at a giant glowing ember-scaled salamander coiled around a steaming red spring in a black rock bowl, dusk

recent.narration:
You sweep your staff and a roaring wave of water leaps from it, slamming into the beast's flank. Steam explodes outward in a scalding cloud. The salamander shrieks, scales dimming where the water struck.

Then it lunges. Its tail whips through the steam and clips your ribs, hot as a forge poker, as the yellow eyes lock on you.
recent.picture: Very muscular man in his thirties, short dark hair, strong jaw, dark green travelling scarf over plain linen shirt, leather boots, carrying a wooden staff, hurling a roaring surge of water at a huge ember-scaled salamander beside a glowing red spring, clouds of steam, dusk

recent.narration: You slam your staff into the rock and pull the wet air toward you. Water sheets across the ground ahead of the charging beast and snaps to ice. The salamander hits the glaze and skids, claws shrieking, steam boiling off its belly. It crashes into a boulder and snarls, scales dimming. The ice is already cracking and sagging under its heat.
recent.picture: Very muscular man in his thirties, short dark hair, strong jaw, dark green travelling scarf over plain linen shirt, leather boots, wooden staff raised, a sheet of ice spreading across black rock as a huge ember-scaled salamander skids on it, steam clouds, dusk, red glowing spring behind

recent.action: Slam it with another cold wave
recent.narration: You drag the staff through the air and a second wave surges out, colder than the first, crashing over the salamander as it struggles free of the ice. Steam bursts in a white wall. The beast screams, its glow sinking to a dull orange, and it staggers back toward the spring, thick tail dragging. Its yellow eyes stay fixed on you, wary now, not furious.
recent.picture: Very muscular man in his thirties, short dark hair, strong jaw, dark green travelling scarf over plain linen shirt, leather boots, sweeping a wooden staff as a huge cold wave of water crashes onto a huge ember-scaled salamander with yellow eyes, billowing steam, black rock bowl, glowing red spring, dusk

recent.action: Smash the cooled scales with your staff
recent.narration: You charge in and swing the staff at its cooled scales. They ring like cracked pottery, but the blow skips off and the beast twists. Its heavy tail sweeps your legs, and you hit the rock hard, ribs aching. Sparks scatter around you. The salamander looms, sides heaving, dimmer but still dangerous.
recent.picture: Very muscular man in his thirties, short dark hair, strong jaw, dark green travelling scarf over plain linen shirt, leather boots, swinging a wooden staff at a huge ember-scaled salamander with yellow eyes, sparks flying, steam, black rock bowl, glowing red spring, dusk

action: Freeze the spring's edge around it
